description: Enables the default permissions. The http scope allows the IGDB proxy and the image CDN and nothing else: id.twitch.tv, api.igdb.com and query.wikidata.org were removed when functions/proxy.js took over the credential, so a regression that calls an upstream directly fails here instead of quietly working. The proxy origin is duplicated from VITE_PROXY_ORIGIN because a capability file cannot read the environment -- change the Worker hostname and change it here too.
